# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Oil at Friendship Prices (scripted effects)
# Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_OILFRIEND_generator/build.py - do not edit by hand.
# A supplier sells oil to a partner below the market price. The partner's oil price falls by
# up to 40 % x its import dependency x how much of its imports the suppliers' spare oil covers.
# Who supplies matters: the spare oil of a supplier is shared by all its partners. The supplier pays the difference.

# Supplier scope, PREV = the partner. Called by the diplomatic action.
COLDWAR_OF_grant = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: oil at friendship prices for [PREV.GetName]"
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = COLDWAR_OF_targets value = PREV } } } add_to_array = { array = COLDWAR_OF_targets value = PREV } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_exempt_targets value = PREV } } } add_to_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_exempt_targets value = PREV } }
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_OF_supplier
	PREV = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = COLDWAR_OF_sources value = PREV } } } add_to_array = { array = COLDWAR_OF_sources value = PREV } }
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_OF_friendship_oil }
		COLDWAR_OF_recalc_partner = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_OF_recalc_supplier = yes
	mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
}

# Supplier scope, PREV = the partner.
COLDWAR_OF_revoke = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: ends oil at friendship prices for [PREV.GetName]"
	remove_from_array = { array = COLDWAR_OF_targets value = PREV }
	remove_from_array = { array = mdcw_cw_oil_exempt_targets value = PREV }
	PREV = {
		remove_from_array = { array = COLDWAR_OF_sources value = PREV }
		remove_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_OF_friendship_oil }
		COLDWAR_OF_recalc_partner = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_OF_recalc_supplier = yes
	mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
}

# Any country, every month: spare oil (exporters) and oil imports (importers), in resource units.
COLDWAR_OF_measure = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_spare = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_need = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { resource_produced@oil > resource_consumed@oil } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_spare = resource_produced@oil }
		subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_spare = resource_consumed@oil }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { resource_consumed@oil > resource_produced@oil } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_need = resource_consumed@oil }
		subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_need = resource_produced@oil }
	}
}

# Supplier scope: how much of its partners' oil imports its spare oil covers (0 to 1).
# The spare oil is shared by all partners: a big exporter covers them fully, a small one only in part.
COLDWAR_OF_supplier_cover = {
	COLDWAR_OF_measure = yes
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_need_all = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = COLDWAR_OF_targets
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_need_all = PREV.COLDWAR_OF_need } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_cover = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_spare > 0 } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_cover = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_need_all > 0 } }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_cover = COLDWAR_OF_spare }
			divide_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_cover = COLDWAR_OF_need_all }
			clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_OF_cover min = 0 max = 1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_cover_pct = COLDWAR_OF_cover }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_cover_pct = 100 }
}

# Partner scope: the discount on its oil price.
COLDWAR_OF_recalc_partner = {
	COLDWAR_OF_measure = yes
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_import_dep = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { resource_consumed@oil > resource_produced@oil } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_import_dep = resource_consumed@oil }
		subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_import_dep = resource_produced@oil }
		divide_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_import_dep = resource_consumed@oil }
	}
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_cover_sum = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = COLDWAR_OF_sources
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			COLDWAR_OF_supplier_cover = yes
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_cover_sum = PREV.COLDWAR_OF_cover } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_discount = COLDWAR_OF_cover_sum }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_OF_discount min = 0 max = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_discount = 0.4 }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_discount = COLDWAR_OF_import_dep }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_discount_pct = COLDWAR_OF_discount }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_discount_pct = 100 }
	# the monthly subsidy this partner receives (share of its GDP, scaled by the oil price)
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_subsidy = gdp_total }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_subsidy = COLDWAR_OF_import_dep }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_subsidy = 0.001 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.imp_global_oil_price }
		multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_subsidy = global.imp_global_oil_price }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level } multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_subsidy = global.mdcw_cw_oil_level } }
		divide_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_subsidy = 75 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwof_t_cov = COLDWAR_OF_cover_sum }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwof_t_cov min = 0 max = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_subsidy = cwof_t_cov }
}

# Supplier scope: what the deliveries cost us every month.
COLDWAR_OF_recalc_supplier = {
	COLDWAR_OF_supplier_cover = yes
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_cost = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_partners = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = COLDWAR_OF_targets
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_partners = 1 } }
			# our part of the partner's subsidy = our coverage / all coverage (at least 1)
			set_temp_variable = { cwof_t_part = PREV.COLDWAR_OF_cover }
			set_temp_variable = { cwof_t_all = COLDWAR_OF_cover_sum }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwof_t_all < 1 } } set_temp_variable = { cwof_t_all = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_cover_sum > 0 } } divide_temp_variable = { cwof_t_part = COLDWAR_OF_cover_sum } multiply_temp_variable = { cwof_t_part = COLDWAR_OF_cover_sum } divide_temp_variable = { cwof_t_part = cwof_t_all } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwof_t_bill = COLDWAR_OF_subsidy }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_cover_sum > 0 } } divide_temp_variable = { cwof_t_bill = COLDWAR_OF_cover_sum } }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwof_t_bill = cwof_t_part }
			PREV = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_cost = cwof_t_bill } }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_partners < 1 } } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_OF_supplier }
}

# Supplier scope, every month: recalculate partners, then pay.
COLDWAR_OF_monthly = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = COLDWAR_OF_targets
		if = {
			limit = { exists = no }
			PREV = { remove_from_array = { array = COLDWAR_OF_targets value = PREV } }
		}
		else = { COLDWAR_OF_recalc_partner = yes }
	}
	COLDWAR_OF_recalc_supplier = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_OF_cost > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_OF_cost }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
	# a war with a partner ends its deliveries
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = COLDWAR_OF_targets
		if = { limit = { has_war_with = PREV } PREV = { COLDWAR_OF_revoke = yes } }
	}
}
